description: A comprehensive side-by-side comparison table contrasting OpenUI with legacy UI libraries across specs.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Swiss
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Compact
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Interactive Feature Comparison Interaction: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
